name: Flow Field
description: Full-area canvas background where hundreds of particles trace colorful trails along a Perlin noise flow field. Clicking shifts the palette and flow direction.
contents: Full-size canvas with animated particle trails on a solid background
behavior: Particles follow a 3D Perlin noise vector field that evolves over time
Trails fade through a translucent background fill each frame
Click re-randomizes the colors and rotates the flow direction
editableByProps: Background color, particle count, trail length, stroke weight and alpha
Flow scale, base direction, particle speeds, saturation and lightness ranges, hue offset

needsCodeEdit.change: Support named background colors other than black

fixed: Fills its parent and is at least one viewport tall
Trail fade supports only hex colors or black for bgColor
